# Finite extreme polar-mean repair15
All fixtures are synthetic3.0/4.0/5.0 numerical stress inputs derived from the
existing forecast09 framing. Their values are not weather observations.
Constant nodes decode to finite +/-Double.MAX; the exact constant mean remains
finite. REFERENCE.json records packed integers, decoded binary64 preconditions
and independent exact Fraction mean/half-band expectations. No ecCodes or data
download rerun; the decoder and zero-bit/scale semantics are unchanged.
Only a nonfinite accumulated sample result triggers the scaled normalised retry.
Contributor weights/CSV schema remain; stable arithmetic is required if a
consumer recomputes extreme weighted means. Tests do not claim universal accuracy.
The separate15 report preserves the before failure and an explicitly unproven
initial candidate, raw checks, actual external consumer builds and archive pins.
